Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
You forgot about this:  The cost to influence Ankla Hotep into play is reduced by 1 pool if you control a ready Setite, or is reduced by 2 pool if you control Nefertiti (any version). Any Justicar you control may take an action at +1 stealth to search your library for an Archon card and put that card in your hand (discard down afterwards). Any Cardinal you control may take an action at +1 stealth to search your library for a Templar card and put that card in your hand (discard down afterwards). If you control a ready vampire who has a city title for Berlin, then he or she gains +1 strength and +1 bleed.
Well, this is not Gehenna, but it is something. The story will be told AFTER the games are played.

Plus, it seems to be better not to have tons of new cards for a storyline event. I wonder what happened to "The Red Sign" ...

Maybe take a look on older events here: www.vekn.net/storyline-events/official-storyline-events
